design: Use exactly the M8/M20 differential pairs. Match the same positive-flux stars in G1 and G2 across both exposures. Fit each calibration, aperture-centre convention and green parity separately with median log(reference flux / target flux). Withhold each tile of stars in turn and predict the ratios in that tile. Record unadjusted and adjusted held-out residuals. The envelope spans every fit variant and withheld tile; it is a sensitivity envelope, not a confidence interval. Unit gain remains the baseline for the previous diffuse test.
